 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Three vertical repeats with alternating reflected row order; each row is mirrored then joined to itself.
    h = len(grid)
    row_order = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))
    return [list(reversed(grid[i])) + list(grid[i]) for i in row_order]
